User.title: User
User.description: Stores user profiles, subscriptions, streak metrics, and achievements.

role.description: User role, default to user. Admins can access dashboard features.

streakCount.description: Number of consecutive days of mathematics study.

lastActiveAt.description: Timestamp indicating the user's last log-in or activity action.

Bookmark.title: Bookmark
Bookmark.description: User bookmarks for algebraic/geometric formulas, problem templates, and quiz items.

userId.description: Reference to the owner user's document ID.

category.description: Type of item (e.g., algebra, geometry, quiz, calculator_template).

itemKey.description: Unique key representing the math resource item within the application.

Progress.title: Progress
Progress.description: Performance and completion trackers for practice quizzes, drills, and formula drills.

userId.description: Reference to the owner user's ID.

activityName.description: Description of activity (e.g., Multiplication table 7 drill).

score.description: Correct answers scored, if a test.

users/{userId}.description: Contains overall profile, plan status, and daily activity tracking metadata.

users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: List of user-saved educational formulas and math references.

users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: Tracks completed mathematics topics and score summaries.
